all.source_quote: Minimum age:10 years (minors can open accounts with a guardian)

unmodelled.text: Must not already have a basic savings bank account (an existing one can be converted)
unmodelled.source_quote: Must not already have a basic savings bank account (or can convert an existing account into a PMJDVaccount)

unmodelled.text: Needs basic KYC documents (Aadhaar, voter ID, PAN, etc.)
unmodelled.source_quote: Requires basic KYC documents (Aadhaar card, voter ID, PAN, etc.)

unmodelled.text: Without KYC documents, a Small Account with limits can be opened
unmodelled.source_quote: If KYC documents are not available, a Small Account can be opened with simplified documentation (subject to certain limits)

unmodelled.text: Priority to unbanked people, especially in rural areas
unmodelled.source_quote: Priority given to unbanked and financially excluded individuals, especially in rural areas

Minors aged 10 and above open the account with a guardian

en.title: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana
en.benefit: Zero-balance savings account with a RuPay card, accident cover of about Rs 2 lakh and an overdraft of up to Rs 10,000 for eligible holders.
en.how_to_apply: Visit a bank branch or Bank Mitra outlet, fill the PMJDY form and submit KYC documents (or open a Small Account).
